▪ Funded Income: Interest income on loans and advances grew by 10% y/y while on government securities,
and bank placements grew by 13% compensating for the decline in the yield on loans. Interest expenses, were
up 17.0% y/y due increased uptake in borrowed funds and rise in customer deposits
▪ Non Funded Income: Fees and commissions on loans and advances mirrored the 28.5% y/y growth in loan
book. The 19.0% y/y increase in Diaspora remittances as well as increase in remittance market share to 16.8%
also supported the15% y/y growth in foreign exchange trading income
